reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in our DM (DPROMPT0001) to confirm the note: Maren Brevik is now his go-to escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Bittern rollout.

I don't have a separate memory store. The note lives in that DM, so that's where I'll look if he asks about it later. I told him it stays between us and won't come up in channels or anyone else's conversations. He said no action was needed, so I didn't send any mail, add calendar entries or post anywhere else.

My first attempt to send the reply failed because I addressed it by his full name. I looked up his handle in the directory and resent it, and it went through.
